verdict.rationale: The CLI runs an MCP server locally with hot reload plus an inspector (manufact-docs-15). The dashboard can also connect to any pasted MCP URL, with no deploy, for Chat and testing (manufact-docs-2, manufact-docs-23), so a server can be tried before integrating it. However, the docs never say the inspector is browser-based or describe calling individual tools by hand, and the dashboard Chat is an LLM-mediated playground rather than a direct tool-calling inspector. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browser-based inspector UI, a description of invoking individual tools with custom arguments and seeing their responses, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the inspector or playground.
